plugins.name: travel-planner
plugins.description: Guides Claude through planning any trip end-to-end — road trips, flights, international travel, city breaks — using a 7-step workflow: activity & dining discovery, adversarial feasibility (pacing, weather, budget, safety, legality, seasonal routes), trip readiness (visa, packing, vaccinations, insurance), schedule, tasks, and reminders — all built around a connector-agnostic travel plan that syncs with your calendar, itinerary, and task apps. Includes slash commands for direct invocation.

plugins.name: triforce
plugins.description: An orchestrated build-and-audit workflow whose reviewer stops. zelda plans and merges on Opus, link executes in an isolated git worktree on Sonnet, and ganondorf renders a verdict on the merged diff against a frozen, user-sourced criteria list — three tier variants (sonnet/opus/fable) selected by a preflight risk score. Fixes are then checked by a verifier whose schema has no findings array, so it cannot generate. The audit is required but never blocking, and terminates because a monotone per-branch invocation ledger bounds it, not because the reviewer decides it is done.
